source: Hnn…
Wh-Wha…? What’s going on out there?
translation: 什、什么……？外面怎么回事？

source: Wh-What?! Don’t tell me the construction crew is here already?! I thought they were supposed to arrive a little later today?!
translation: 什、什么？！施工队不会已经来了吧？！他们不是应该今天晚些时候才到吗？！

source: If I had known, I would’ve woken up sooner!
translation: 早知道的话，我就早点起床了！

source: I have to get ready quick!
translation: 我得赶紧准备好！

source: Oh, you’re awake, Yoshi!
translation: 哦，你醒了，Yoshi！

source: Hihi~ You’re not the first one up for once!
translation: 嘻嘻～你难得不是第一个起床的人！

source: Why didn’t you guys wake me up? I didn’t know the workers were coming this early.
translation: 你们为什么不叫醒我？我不知道工人们会这么早过来。

source: Oh, they aren’t the workers, Yoshi! They’re just here to deliver the building materials!
translation: 哦，他们不是工人，Yoshi！只是来运送建筑材料的！

source: They were supposed to show up at the same time as the workers later, but they got here earlier than scheduled.
translation: 他们原本应该晚些时候和工人同时到达，不过比计划提前来了。

source: Yeah, good thing I was up extra early when they arrived or else nobody would’ve been around to let them in!
translation: 是啊，幸好他们到的时候我起得特别早，否则这里根本没人给他们开门！

source: Oh, that’s a relief… For a minute there, I thought I’d be late on our first day of renovations.
translation: 哦，那就好……刚才有一瞬间，我还以为翻修第一天自己就要迟到了。

source: If it weren’t for the ruckus outside, I wouldn’t have woken up either.
translation: 要不是外面闹出这么大动静，我也不会醒。

source: It looks like we need to be more prepared for the unexpected from here on.
translation: 看来从现在起，我们得为突发情况做好更充分的准备。

source: Speaking of which, Mr. Clermont gave us the specifics of today’s agenda this morning. Dad told me to relay the info to you guys!
translation: 说起来，Clermont先生今天早上发来了今日安排的具体内容。爸爸让我把信息转告给你们！

source: Where’s Gramps anyways? Shouldn’t he be the one briefing us on all of this?
translation: 话说Gramps去哪儿了？这些事不该由他向我们说明吗？

source: Dad left super early a while ago… He said he’s gonna run some errands… He didn’t tell me what they were though…
translation: 爸爸很早以前就出门了……他说要去办些事……不过没告诉我具体是什么……

source: Based on yesterday’s meeting, I believe he’s out today handling the permits at city hall.
translation: 根据昨天的会议，我想他今天是去市政厅办理许可证了。

source: Either way, we should be able to take care of everything ourselves!
translation: 无论如何，我们自己应该能处理好一切！

source: Yes! There are only two things Dad assigned for today – matching the deliveries with the materials list and prepare for the workers’ arrival.
translation: 没错！爸爸今天只安排了两件事——按照材料清单核对送来的货物，以及为工人们的到来作准备。

source: Let me handle the deliveries, Yuri. You can go and prepare the cabins the workers are staying at.
translation: 送货的事情交给我吧，Yuri。你可以去准备工人们要住的木屋。

source: Oh, I already took care of those! I was up past midnight dusting off the floors and putting sheets on the beds.
translation: 哦，那些我已经处理好了！昨晚过了午夜我还没睡，一直在清扫地板、给床铺上床单。

source: Y-Yuri… You’re getting distracted already… Try to make sure you fully check and count all the materials properly.
translation: 尤、Yuri……你已经开始分心了……一定要把所有材料仔细检查并清点准确。

source: Heh, knowing Yuri, she’ll do a full check alright~
translation: 呵，以我对Yuri的了解，她肯定会来一次彻底“检查”～

source: Ahh… To be blessed with such a show all for myself~ I love this job so much!
translation: 啊……能独享这样的表演，真是太有福气了～我太爱这份工作了！

source: *ehem* Anyway, did we get an update on the number of workers moving in later today?
translation: *清嗓子* 总之，今天晚些时候会入住多少工人，有最新消息吗？

source: Ah, yes, we’re expecting the first batch to be approximately thirty people.
translation: 啊，有，第一批预计大约三十人。

source: Yikes! You mean I have to feed that many too?! I only prepared for half of that last night…!
translation: 天啊！你是说我还得给这么多人做饭？！昨晚我只准备了大约一半人的量……！

source: Yikes! You mean I have to feed that many too?! I only prepared for half of that last night…!{fast}
translation: 天啊！你是说我还得给这么多人做饭？！昨晚我只准备了大约一半人的量……！{fast}

source: Can you finish in time?
translation: 你能及时完成吗？

source: Will you be able to have everything prepped in time, Aiden? It seems like a lot to do…
translation: Aiden，你能及时把一切准备好吗？看起来工作量很大……

source: Yeah, I could seriously use a hand.
translation: 是啊，我真的需要有人帮忙。

source: If you’re not too busy, maybe you can help me out, Yoshi?
translation: Yoshi，如果你不太忙，也许可以来帮帮我？

source: Are you sure? I’m not much use in the kitchen…
translation: 你确定吗？我在厨房里帮不上太多忙……

source: No way, you could help me cut up the ingredients at least!
translation: 怎么会，你至少可以帮我切食材！

source: Alright, if it’ll help!
translation: 好吧，只要能帮上忙！

source: I don't have any plans.
translation: 我没有其他安排。

source: I don’t have any plans until the workers arrive, and since Yuri’s got the deliveries covered…
translation: 工人到达前我都没有其他安排，而且送货工作已经有Yuri负责……

source: Oh! How about you come with me then?
translation: 哦！那你和我一起去怎么样？

source: Sure, I don’t mind!
translation: 当然，我不介意！

source: Why don't I give you a hand?
translation: 不如让我来帮你？

source: Why don’t I give you a hand, Aiden? I’m sure it’ll make your job easier!
translation: 不如让我来帮你吧，Aiden？肯定能让你的工作轻松一些！

source: You’re a lifesaver, Yoshi! I’m not sure I could do it all by myself in time!
translation: 你真是救了我的命，Yoshi！我都不确定自己一个人能不能及时全部做完！

source: Haha, I’ve seen you pull off even tighter deadlines. But I’m happy to make it easier on you today!
translation: 哈哈，我见过你在更紧迫的时间里完成任务。不过今天能让你轻松一点，我很高兴！

source: Thanks, Yoshi! Come on, let’s go!
translation: 谢谢，Yoshi！来吧，我们走！

source: I'll help you cook.
translation: 我来帮你做饭。

source: Let me help you cook, Aiden! You sound like you could use an assistant chef!
translation: 让我来帮你做饭吧，Aiden！听起来你正需要一名助理厨师！

source: I can help you prep and cut up the ingredients to save you some time!
translation: 我可以帮你准备和切好食材，节省一些时间！

source: That sounds great, Yoshi! I’d love to have you in the kitchen with me!
translation: 听起来太棒了，Yoshi！我很乐意让你和我一起待在厨房！

source: Let’s go then!
translation: 那就走吧！

source: Hehe… Now, where did I put my camera~?
translation: 嘿嘿……我的相机放在哪里了～？

source: Hey, you sure you’re gonna work with all those clothes on?
translation: 嘿，你确定要穿着这么多衣服干活吗？

source: A-Ah… I’m fine, Aiden! Won’t you get cold like that though?
translation: 啊、啊……我没问题，Aiden！不过你穿成这样不会冷吗？

source: Nah! It’s gonna be really hot in here later once we start cooking everything up!
translation: 不会！等会儿开始做所有菜以后，这里会变得特别热！

source: S-So, what are we making today, and how can I help?
translation: 那、那么，我们今天要做什么？我能怎么帮忙？

source: Hmmmm… Since I’m cooking for a bunch of active dudes, I’m expecting them to have huge appetites!
translation: 嗯……既然是给一群精力充沛的男人做饭，我估计他们胃口都会很大！

source: A nice, hearty meal packed with protein and nutrients should keep their energy up after a long day!
translation: 一顿富含蛋白质和营养的丰盛饭菜，应该能让他们在漫长的一天后保持体力！

source: Luckily for me, that’s usually the same category of food the scouts love, so I have a menu that I prepped before that we can use!
translation: 幸运的是，这通常也是童军们喜欢的食物类型，所以我以前准备过一份菜单，现在正好能用！

source: Oh wow… This seems like a lot to do… and you have to make thirty servings of this?!
translation: 哦，哇……看起来要做很多事……而且你得做三十人份？！

source: Haha, yeah! Welcome to my world! That’s why my little chef, Hiro, was such a big help back during the summer!
translation: 哈哈，没错！欢迎来到我的世界！所以去年夏天，我的小厨师Hiro才帮了大忙！

source: To be honest, though, I’m really excited! It’s been a while since I cooked for a lot of people, haha!
translation: 不过说实话，我真的很兴奋！我已经有段时间没给这么多人做饭了，哈哈！

source: And with your help, this’ll be a breeze! You’ll be my sous chef!
translation: 再加上你的帮助，一切都会轻而易举！你来做我的副厨师！

source: It really has been a while since I’ve helped out in the kitchen. I hope we can finish in time.
translation: 我确实已经很久没在厨房帮忙了。希望我们能及时完成。

source: Haha, yeah, it’s like a pressure cooker in here, ’specially when the people start coming inside the mess hall!
translation: 哈哈，是啊，这里会像压力锅一样，特别是大家开始涌进食堂的时候！

source: Speaking of which, put on an apron and let's start prepping these ingredients already!
translation: 说起来，穿上围裙，我们赶紧开始准备食材吧！

source: Right!
translation: 好！

source: Hehe, it feels so nostalgic to have you in the kitchen again, Yoshi.
translation: 呵呵，Yoshi，再次和你一起待在厨房，感觉真怀念。

source: Ever since you became a full-fledged scoutmaster, you hardly get to help me cook!
translation: 自从你成为正式的童军团长后，就很少有机会帮我做饭了！

source: I don’t blame you though. You have way more important duties now anyways.
translation: 不过我不怪你，毕竟你现在有重要得多的职责。

source: W-Well, I do try to help you out sometimes when my schedule is loose.
translation: 这、这个嘛，日程宽松的时候，我确实会尽量来帮你。

source: Yeah, like once or twice every term!
translation: 是啊，每个营期大概一两次！

source: I’m not sure if I’m even helping though… I’m not as good of a cook as you are.
translation: 不过我都不确定自己算不算帮上忙……我的厨艺没有你好。

source: It’s not about the skill, it’s about the company! Food made with TLC is the best kind!
translation: 重要的不是技术，而是有人陪伴！用 TLC 做出的食物才是最棒的！

source: That stands for tomatoes, lettuce, and cheese, right…? I didn’t know we were making burgers today.
translation: TLC 是番茄、生菜和奶酪的缩写，对吧……？我都不知道我们今天要做汉堡。

source: I meant tender loving care, silly! Sheesh…
translation: 我说的是 Tender Loving Care，也就是温柔的关爱，笨蛋！真是的……

source: Having someone to cook with or cook for is what makes a dish a lot more special.
translation: 有人陪你一起做饭，或者有值得为之做饭的人，才会让一道菜变得更加特别。

source: I guess you do have a point… I mean, I know I have more fun with my job here at the camp, especially when the scouts are around.
translation: 我想你确实有道理……我是说，我知道自己在营地工作时更快乐，特别是童军们在的时候。

source: Yeah, you always get hyped up about any activities you get to do with them.
translation: 是啊，只要能和他们一起参加活动，你总会特别兴奋。

source: Just like when you did them as a scout! You wanted to try everything and be good at all of it!
translation: 就像你自己当童军时一样！什么都想尝试，而且每样都想做好！

source: That kinda reminds me of when you were interested in cooking a long time ago – we used to spend so much time in the kitchen together!
translation: 这让我想起很久以前你对烹饪感兴趣的时候——我们以前经常一起在厨房里待很久！

source: Ahh, yeah… I remember!  That was when you were helping me earn my cooking badge.
translation: 啊，是啊……我记得！那时你在帮我获得烹饪徽章。

source: Ugh… That stupid cooking badge. As soon as you got it, you stopped trying to get better at cooking.
translation: 唉……那枚该死的烹饪徽章。你一拿到它，就不再努力提高厨艺了。

source: Ugh… That stupid cooking badge. As soon as you got it, you stopped trying to get better at cooking.{fast}
translation: 唉……那枚该死的烹饪徽章。你一拿到它，就不再努力提高厨艺了。{fast}

source: You were always so much better at it.
translation: 你一直都比我擅长得多。

source: Well, you were always so much better at it than I was.
translation: 这个嘛，你的厨艺一直都比我好得多。

source: You saw the stuff I cooked back then, and it was barely edible. That’s why I felt like cooking wasn’t for me to begin with.
translation: 你见过我当时做的东西，几乎都没法吃。所以我觉得自己从一开始就不适合烹饪。

source: It’s a good thing you got the hang of it in the end though!
translation: 不过幸好最后你还是掌握了诀窍！

source: Cooking isn't my strongest suit.
translation: 烹饪不是我的强项。

source: W-Well, it’s not that I wasn’t interested anymore. I just thought it wasn’t my strongest suit.
translation: 这、这个嘛，并不是我不再感兴趣，只是觉得烹饪不是自己的强项。

source: I prefer your cooking.
translation: 我更喜欢你做的菜。

source: I’d much rather have your cooking than mine!
translation: 比起自己做的，我更想吃你做的菜！

source: You’ve always been so good at it, so I never needed to get any better.
translation: 你一直都这么擅长，所以我根本不需要让自己变得更好。

source: Hehe, I guess if you put it that way.
translation: 嘿嘿，既然你这么说，好吧。

source: After all, I’ve seen and tasted the stuff you made, and I have to say – I never thought I’d see meat and chocolate in a dish together…
translation: 毕竟我见过也尝过你做的东西。不得不说——我从没想过会在一道菜里同时看到肉和巧克力……

source: G-Gah! I swear I didn’t mean to do that!
translation: 呃、呃啊！我发誓那不是故意的！

source: Hahaha! That’s the same look you had every time you messed up, even after I taught you!
translation: 哈哈哈！即使我教过你以后，你每次搞砸时还是这副表情！

source: You're always there to cook for me.
translation: 你一直都在为我做饭。

source: Haha, why would I need to when I have you around to cook for me~?
translation: 哈哈，既然有你在身边为我做饭，我为什么还需要提高厨艺呢～？

source: Your food is already the best, so there’s no way anyone could compete!
translation: 你做的食物已经是最棒的，根本没人能与你竞争！

source: Hmm, well, since you’re flirting, I guess I can give you a pass~
translation: 嗯，这个嘛，既然你都开始调情了，我就放你一马～

source: Yeah, I did struggle earning that cooking badge… but I had a lot of fun with you because of it!
translation: 是啊，为了获得烹饪徽章，我确实吃了不少苦……但也因为这件事，我和你一起度过了很多快乐时光！

source: You know, I'm really thankful for that badge – if it wasn't for it, I probably wouldn't have met you.
translation: 你知道吗，我真的很感谢那枚徽章——如果不是它，我可能根本不会遇见你。

source: It was the reason I got to stay here at Camp Buddy in the first place!
translation: 正是因为它，我才有机会留在 Camp Buddy！

source: Okay, Aiden, I know I promised that I’d take care of you today, but we have an emergency staff meeting…
translation: 好了，Aiden，我知道自己答应今天照顾你，但我们临时要开一场员工紧急会议……

source: I’m not allowed to bring visitors as per the camp policy, but luckily Sir Goro made an exception and is letting you wait here due to our circumstances…
translation: 按照营地规定，我不能带访客进来。不过幸好情况特殊，Goro先生破例允许你在这里等候……

source: I need you to stay put for a while until the meeting is over. I promise I won’t be gone for too long, so don’t go goofing around, okay?
translation: 会议结束前，你得在这里待一会儿。我保证不会离开太久，所以别到处乱跑，好吗？

source: Okay, Dad. I don’t mind waiting.
translation: 好的，爸爸。我不介意等。

source: Great! I’ll be back soon, Aiden!
translation: 很好！我很快就回来，Aiden！

source: Come on, Yuri! I really need that cooking badge! Come and taste the food I made!
translation: 拜托，Yuri！我真的需要那枚烹饪徽章！来尝尝我做的食物！

source: Yoshi… You’ve already made me eat five horrible dishes today! How is this one any different?!
translation: Yoshi……你今天已经让我吃了五道可怕的菜！这一道又能有什么不同？！

source: I’m sure I seasoned this one just right! You’ll see!
translation: 我肯定这次调味刚刚好！你尝了就知道！

source: Oh!
translation: 哦！

source: Hello! You don’t look familiar, are you a new scout?
translation: 你好！你看起来很面生，是新来的童军吗？

source: I… Uhh… No—
translation: 我……呃……不是——

source: Wait, I know you! I saw you come by today with Mr. Andre! Are you his son?
translation: 等等，我认识你！今天我看见你和Andre先生一起来！你是他的儿子吗？

source: Y-Yeah…
translation: 是、是的……

source: Well, a friend of Mr. Andre is a friend of ours! My name’s Yoshinori!
translation: Andre先生的朋友就是我们的朋友！我叫Yoshinori！

source: I’m Yuri!
translation: 我是Yuri！

source: Welcome to Camp Buddy! What’s your name?
translation: 欢迎来到 Camp Buddy！你叫什么名字？

source: Aiden…
translation: Aiden……

source: Nice to meet you, Aiden! What are you doing over here all alone?
translation: 很高兴认识你，Aiden！你一个人在这里做什么？

source: Oh, I’m just waiting for Dad to finish his staff meeting… He asked me to stay put and wait here...
translation: 哦，我只是在等爸爸开完员工会议……他让我待在这里等……

source: Oh, I see… Well, they’re gonna take a while in there for sure! If you want, you can help me with my badge-earning activity!
translation: 哦，明白了……他们肯定要在里面开很久！如果你愿意，可以来帮我完成徽章活动！

source: I’m trying to earn my cooking badge today, and I could use another person to try out the food I made!
translation: 我今天正努力获得烹饪徽章，还需要另一个人试吃我做的食物！

source: Since your dad is the chef here, then that means you should know a thing or two about cooking, right?
translation: 既然你爸爸是这里的厨师，那你应该也懂一点烹饪，对吧？

source: I guess… I do know a little bit about it, yeah…
translation: 我想……是的，我确实懂一点……

source: What a good idea, Yoshi! That means you won’t need me to do the taste-testing after all!
translation: 真是个好主意，Yoshi！这样你就不需要我继续试吃了！

source: H-Hey! You’re not off the hook! Aiden hasn’t agreed yet!
translation: 喂、喂！你还不能溜！Aiden还没答应呢！

source: UGHhhh…
translation: 呃啊啊……

source: I don’t know… Dad told me to stay here and—
translation: 我不知道……爸爸叫我留在这里——

source: No, no! It’ll be fine! Those meetings take HOURS anyways! He won’t even know you’re gone! Just say yes already!!
translation: 不、不！没关系的！那些会议反正一开就是好几个小时！他根本不会知道你离开过！快答应吧！！

source: A-Are you sure I’m not gonna get in trouble…?
translation: 你、你确定我不会惹上麻烦吗……？

source: My dad’s the president of this camp! We can get away with everything!
translation: 我爸爸是这座营地的负责人！我们做什么都不会有事！

source: Wow, really?
translation: 哇，真的吗？

source: Yes, really! So, please, PLEASE, save me from having another tummy ache today, Aiden!!
translation: 真的！所以求你了，求求你，Aiden，别让我今天再吃到肚子痛！！

source: D-Don’t listen to her, Aiden, I made a really yummy pizza back in the kitchen! If you come with me, I’ll let you have the whole thing!
translation: 别、别听她的，Aiden，我在厨房里做了一个特别美味的披萨！你跟我来，整个都给你吃！

source: Pizza?! *tummy grumbles*
translation: 披萨？！*肚子咕咕叫*

source: Sounds like you could use some pizza! It’s gonna be ooey-gooey with cheese too once I heat it up!
translation: 听起来你确实需要来点披萨！等我把它加热，奶酪还会融化得黏稠拉丝！

source: Ahh… That sounds delicious!  I guess… a quick bite wouldn’t hurt.
translation: 啊……听起来真好吃！我想……去快速吃一口应该没关系。

source: Yay! You’re a lifesaver, Aiden! I think we’re gonna be really good friends! *whispers* If you survive the pizza, that is…
translation: 太好了！你救了我的命，Aiden！我想我们会成为非常要好的朋友！*低声* 前提是你能从那个披萨下活下来……

source: Are you sure you really don’t want to come with us, Yuri? I can cook up another one for you, if you’d like!
translation: Yuri，你真的确定不和我们一起去吗？你要是愿意，我可以再给你做一个！

source: No, thank youuuuuu~~
translation: 不——用——了，谢谢～～

source: Oh, and Aiden, make sure to tell Yoshi what you REALLY think about his cooking, okay?!
translation: 哦，还有Aiden，一定要把你对Yoshi厨艺的真实想法告诉他，好吗？！

source: O-Okay…!
translation: 好、好的……！

source: Have fun on your date with the cute new guy, Yoshi~!
translation: Yoshi，和可爱的新男孩约会愉快～！

source: I-It’s not a date!!
translation: 这、这不是约会！！

source: *ehem* Anyway, the food’s waiting in the kitchen! Come on!
translation: *清嗓子* 总之，食物正在厨房等着！来吧！

source: Okay, a little warning, I don’t have a lot of experience cooking, so please don’t expect too much!
translation: 好，先提醒一下，我没有多少烹饪经验，所以请别期待太高！

source: I did try my best making this food though! I used a recipe, but I made sure to add my own twist, and—
translation: 不过我确实尽力做了这道菜！我参考了食谱，同时还加入自己的创意，而且——

source: Aiden…? Are you listening?
translation: Aiden……？你在听吗？

source: O-Oh! I’m sorry, Yoshinori…! It’s just… I’ve never seen a really fancy kitchen like this in person before…
translation: 哦、哦！对不起，Yoshinori……！只是……我以前从没亲眼见过这么豪华的厨房……

source: A two-door fridge, a built-in oven, and a cooking hob with a range hood too…
translation: 双开门冰箱、嵌入式烤箱，还有带抽油烟机的灶台……

source: We don’t have anything like these back at home…
translation: 我们家里没有这样的东西……

source: Oh, really? That kinda surprises me, considering how good everything Mr. Andre makes here is!
translation: 哦，真的吗？Andre先生在这里做的每样东西都那么美味，这还真让我吃惊！

source: Ah! It’s ready!
translation: 啊！好了！

source: Here’s the pizza I made! Fresh from the “meekrowahvé”!
translation: 这是我做的披萨！刚从“微波哇维”里出炉！

source: You cooked pizza… in the microwave?
translation: 你用微波炉……做了披萨？

source: Yeah! Go ahead, try it!
translation: 对！来吧，尝尝！

source: Alright…
translation: 好吧……

source: *munch*
translation: *咀嚼*

source: Sooo, how is it? Good, right?
translation: 所以，味道怎么样？很好吃，对吧？

source: Umm… Y-Yeah…
translation: 呃……是、是啊……

source: I sensed a bit of hesitation there… Don’t be shy, you can tell me what’s wrong!
translation: 我听出你有点犹豫……别害羞，有什么问题可以告诉我！

source: M-Maybe it’s a little undercooked… I bit into some raw dough underneath.
translation: 也、也许有点没熟……我咬到了下面的生面团。

source: Aww, really? Where did I go wrong…? I followed the recipe exactly.
translation: 啊，真的吗？我哪里做错了……？我完全照着食谱做的。

source: I think it would be a lot better if you used the oven and cooked it a bit longer, since the dough you made is a little thick.
translation: 你做的面团有点厚，如果用烤箱多烤一会儿，应该会好得多。

source: I actually used packaged dough from the freezer since I didn’t know how to make bread… And I didn’t know how to use the oven either…
translation: 其实我不会做面包，所以用了冰箱里的包装冷冻面团……而且我也不知道怎么使用烤箱……

source: H-How about the taste though? I probably can’t get that wrong, right? It’s just pizza!
translation: 那、那味道呢？这个我总不可能弄错，对吧？只不过是披萨！

source: W-Well… the taste is very… interesting… Did you really follow a recipe for this?
translation: 这、这个嘛……味道非常……特别……你真的照着食谱做了吗？

source: Sort of… Some of the ingredients weren’t available, so I did a little bit of substituting…
translation: 算是吧……有些食材找不到，所以我稍微替换了一下……

source: I used ketchup for the sauce since it’s made of tomatoes, and I found some bleu cheese in the fridge, so I thought it would be fancy!
translation: 番茄酱也是用番茄做的，所以我拿它当酱汁；冰箱里还找到了蓝纹奶酪，我觉得这样会很高级！

source: Ehehe… It doesn’t work the same way…
translation: 呃嘿嘿……它们不能这样替换……

source: *sigh* Aww, man… I thought I would’ve been able to pull it off this time!
translation: *叹气* 唉，真是的……我还以为这次能成功！

source: It’s alright! At least you gave it a try! It did make me stuffed, so it’s a win either way!
translation: 没关系！至少你尝试过了！而且它确实让我吃饱了，所以怎么说都算成功！

source: Thanks for being honest and giving me some tips, Aiden. You’re a really nice guy!
translation: 谢谢你坦白告诉我，还给了些建议，Aiden。你真是个好人！

source: And thank you for letting me eat your food, Yoshinori!
translation: 也谢谢你让我吃你做的食物，Yoshinori！

source: You’re welcome! Since we’re friends now, just call me Yoshi!
translation: 不客气！既然我们现在是朋友，叫我Yoshi就好！

source: A-Alright, Yoshi!
translation: 好、好的，Yoshi！

source: Well, I guess I need more practice cooking… *sigh* So much for earning that badge…
translation: 这个嘛，看来我还需要多练习烹饪……*叹气* 烹饪徽章算是没戏了……

source: If you want, maybe I could watch you this time and give you some pointers…?
translation: 如果你愿意，这次也许可以让我在旁边看着，给你一些建议……？

source: Oh! I have an even better idea! How about you show me how to do it instead? Maybe I’ll learn faster that way!
translation: 哦！我有个更好的主意！不如你直接演示给我看？这样我也许学得更快！

source: Wh-What? Right now? I’m not a scout here… Is that really okay?
translation: 什、什么？现在吗？我不是这里的童军……真的可以吗？

source: We’re not doing anything against the rules, so I’m sure it’ll be fine, Aiden! Trust me!
translation: 我们又没有违反任何规定，所以肯定没问题，Aiden！相信我！

source: Besides, don’t you wanna use the kitchen here too?
translation: 而且，你不也想用用这里的厨房吗？

source: Wahh… I-I do…
translation: 哇……我、我确实想……

source: Great, then show me how it’s done and let’s get that cooking badge!
translation: 太好了，那就让我看看该怎么做，一起拿到烹饪徽章吧！

source: Oh, it’s done!
translation: 哦，做好了！

source: Mmm… It smells so good!
translation: 嗯……闻起来好香！

source: Here, let me take it out of the oven!
translation: 来，让我把它从烤箱里拿出来！

source: Tada! And that’s how I make pizza!
translation: 锵锵！我就是这样做披萨的！

source: Woooow!!! My mouth is watering just looking at it!
translation: 哇啊啊！！！光是看着我就流口水了！

source: Sorry, it took a little longer since I had to make the dough and sauce from scratch.
translation: 抱歉，花的时间有点久，因为面团和酱汁都得从头制作。

source: Are you kidding? I can’t believe you made this in less than an hour! I was up all night making mine, hahaha!
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？真不敢相信你不到一小时就做好了！我做自己的那个可是熬了一整夜，哈哈哈！

source: Well, luckily for me, the kitchen here had everything I needed to make it faster. It was my first time trying a food processor, mixer, and an oven!
translation: 这个嘛，幸好这里的厨房拥有加快速度所需的一切。这是我第一次使用食物处理机、搅拌机和烤箱！

source: But you were using the whole kitchen like a pro! It was super cool!
translation: 但你使用整个厨房时简直像专业厨师！特别酷！

source: Ah, hehe… I was honestly just tinkering with it until I figured it out – turns out it was pretty simple.
translation: 啊，嘿嘿……说实话，我只是不断摸索，直到弄明白——结果发现还挺简单。

source: Anyways, go ahead, give it a taste while it’s still hot!
translation: 总之，来吧，趁热尝尝！

source: I thought you’d never ask!
translation: 我还以为你永远不会开口呢！

source: H-How is it?
translation: 味、味道怎么样？

source: IT’S SO YUMMY!!! This is the best pizza I’ve ever tasted in my entire life!
translation: 太好吃了！！！这是我一生中吃过最棒的披萨！

source: A-Ahh… I think you’re exaggerating…
translation: 啊、啊……我觉得你太夸张了……

source: I’m not! I never thought I’d like pineapples on my pizza!
translation: 才没有！我从没想过自己会喜欢披萨上的菠萝！

source: Aww… Well, I’m really glad you like my cooking, Yoshi!
translation: 啊……这个嘛，你喜欢我做的食物，我真的很高兴，Yoshi！

source: Th-There you are, Aiden! I’ve been looking for you!
translation: 原、原来你在这里，Aiden！我一直在找你！

source: D-Dad…!
translation: 爸、爸爸……！

source: *sigh* Didn’t I tell you to stay in the mess hall?
translation: *叹气* 我不是让你待在食堂吗？

source: Oh, I’m sorry about that, Mr. Andre…! I was the one who invited Aiden to help me with my badge-earning activity!
translation: 哦，对不起，Andre先生……！是我邀请Aiden来帮助自己完成徽章活动的！

source: Whew… It’s a good thing he ran into you. I was worried he ran off somewhere outside Camp Buddy…
translation: 呼……幸好他遇见了你。我还担心他跑到 Camp Buddy 外面的什么地方去了……

source: Hey, Mr. Andre! How come you’ve never brought Aiden here before? He’s a really great guy, and his cooking is amazing, just like yours!
translation: 对了，Andre先生！您以前为什么从没带Aiden来这里？他人特别好，厨艺也和您一样了不起！

source: He’s been by himself back at home ever since I started working here, so I asked Sir Goro a favor to let me bring him for today.
translation: 自从我开始在这里工作，他就一直独自在家，所以今天我请Goro先生帮忙，允许我带他过来。

source: You should bring him more often, then! I’d be happy for him to tag along with me all day!
translation: 那您应该经常带他来！我很乐意让他整天跟我一起活动！

source: Ah, we’re not really allowed to bring visitors to the camp, actually… Today was just an exception since we had a meeting, and I’ll be working until late tonight.
translation: 啊，其实我们不能随便把访客带进营地……今天只是因为要开会，而我会工作到深夜，所以才破例。

source: Oh, how about enrolling him here as a scout, then? That would be so fun!! Don’t you think so, Aiden?!
translation: 哦，那让他报名成为这里的童军怎么样？一定会特别有趣！！你不这么觉得吗，Aiden？！

source: Oh…!
We can do all the activities together! We can go hiking, fishing, and you can teach me how to cook until I get my cooking badge!
translation: 我们可以一起参加所有活动！可以去徒步、钓鱼，你还可以教我做饭，直到我拿到烹饪徽章！

source: A-Ah, well, Yoshinori… I’m not sure if that’s possible…
translation: 啊、啊，这个嘛，Yoshinori……我不确定这能不能实现……

source: O-Oh…
translation: 哦、哦……

source: I do wish he could come with me more often, but Sir Goro has already done enough for me that I don’t want to ask any more of him.
translation: 我确实希望他能经常和我一起来，但Goro先生已经为我做得够多了，我不想再向他提出更多请求。

source: I see… That’s a shame…
translation: 我明白了……真遗憾……

source: Aiden is a really talented cook just like you are, Mr. Andre! Look, he made this really yummy pizza from scratch just a little while ago!
translation: Andre先生，Aiden和您一样是位很有天赋的厨师！看，他刚才从头做出了这个特别美味的披萨！

source: Ah, haha… I’d like to say I’m surprised, but cooking has been Aiden’s favorite thing to do since he was little!
translation: 啊，哈哈……我本想说自己很惊讶，可烹饪从小就是Aiden最喜欢做的事！

source: That's why I understand how you feel about Aiden not being able to be a part of the camp.
translation: 所以我能理解，你对Aiden无法成为营地一员的遗憾。

source: That's why I understand how you feel about Aiden not being able to be a part of the camp.{fast}
translation: 所以我能理解，你对Aiden无法成为营地一员的遗憾。{fast}

source: It's too bad he can't stay.
translation: 他不能留下来太可惜了。

source: It really is too bad he can’t stay, then… I think he could really make a difference at the camp.
translation: 那么，他不能留下来真的太可惜了……我觉得他能为营地带来很大改变。

source: As much as I’d like that… I don’t know how…
translation: 我也很希望如此……但不知道该怎么办……

source: I wish he could stay.
translation: 我希望他能留下。

source: If only there was some way to have Aiden stay here…
translation: 要是有什么办法能让Aiden留在这里就好了……

source: Aiden would make a great chef.
translation: Aiden会成为很棒的厨师。

source: There must be a way to have Aiden here at the camp. I’m sure he’d become, like, the best chef ever!
translation: 一定有办法让Aiden留在营地。我相信他会成为有史以来最棒的厨师！

source: Ah…
We could have fun together.
translation: 我们可以一起开心玩耍。

source: There must be a way to have Aiden here at the camp. He wouldn’t be alone back at home anymore, and we could have so much fun together!
translation: 一定有办法让Aiden留在营地。这样他就不用再独自在家，我们也能一起经历很多快乐！

source: M-Maybe I could help you out with the chores, Dad?
translation: 也、也许我可以帮你做杂活，爸爸？

source: You mean… You want to work with me, Aiden?
translation: 你是说……你想和我一起工作，Aiden？

source: Yeah…! I can help us earn some money, and you won’t have to worry about me being at home alone, since we’ll be together all the time!
translation: 是啊……！我可以帮忙赚钱，而且我们会一直在一起，你也不用担心我独自在家！

source: Aiden…
translation: Aiden……

source: Alright. I guess I can talk to Sir Goro about it.
translation: 好吧。我想可以和Goro先生谈谈这件事。

source: Wah…! Really?!
translation: 哇……！真的吗？！

source: I can’t promise you it’ll work, but I’ll do my best to convince him, okay?
translation: 我不能保证一定成功，但会尽力说服他，好吗？

source: Oh, let me help too, Mr. Andre! I’m sure Sir Goro would love to have Aiden here too! Let me just grab Yuri, and we’ll go ask him right away!
translation: 哦，也让我来帮忙，Andre先生！我相信Goro先生也会很乐意让Aiden留在这里！我去叫上Yuri，我们马上就去问他！

source: W-Wait, Yoshinori…!
translation: 等、等等，Yoshinori……！

source: *sigh* That boy is hyper as always…
translation: *叹气* 那孩子还是一如既往地精力旺盛……

source: I guess you really won him over with your cooking, didn’t you, Aiden?
translation: 看来你真的用厨艺赢得了他的心，对吧，Aiden？

source: A-Ah… Well…
translation: 啊、啊……这个嘛……

source: Either way, I’m really glad you made a new friend! Now, come on, let’s go after him!
translation: 无论如何，你交到了新朋友，我真的很高兴！来吧，我们追上他！

source: Yeah!
translation: 好！

source: Thinking about it, it’s crazy how things ended up back then.
translation: 现在想想，当时事情最后竟然变成那样，真不可思议。

source: Growing up, it was just Dad and I, and we didn’t have much.
translation: 我从小只有爸爸陪着，也没有多少东西。

source: Cooking was the thing we bonded over, but it actually led me to you…
translation: 烹饪是我们父子建立感情的纽带，却也把我带到了你身边……

source: And then, thanks to your determination, I was able to start working here!
translation: 后来，多亏了你的坚持，我才能开始在这里工作！

source: It was worth it too! I’ve been able to eat all the delicious food you’ve made over the years, and it’s still the best I’ve ever had!
translation: 一切也都值得！这些年来，我吃到了你做的所有美味食物，至今仍是我吃过最棒的！

source: Well, look at you, Mr. Smooth-Talker! Keep complimenting my cooking like that, and I’ll serve you today's special, if you catch my drift~
translation: 这个嘛，瞧瞧你这位Smooth-Talker先生！继续这样夸我的厨艺，我就给你上今天的“特别套餐”，懂我的意思吧～

source: A-Aiden…!
translation: 艾、Aiden……！

source: Look at you, you're as red as a tomato! You’re still that same dorky scout, hahaha!
translation: 瞧你，脸红得像番茄一样！你还是当年那个呆头呆脑的童军，哈哈哈！

source: L-Let’s just finish cooking! We have to finish before the workers arrive, and we’re getting distracted!
translation: 我、我们还是把饭做完吧！必须赶在工人到来前完成，不能再分心了！

source: Alright, alright! Hahaha!
translation: 好吧，好吧！哈哈哈！

source: {i}It was really nostalgic to work with Aiden in the kitchen… No wonder he was reminiscing about the past.{/i}
translation: {i}和Aiden一起在厨房工作真的令人怀念……难怪他会回忆起过去。{/i}

source: {i}It’s not often he and I have a conversation like that, but I’m glad that we were able to look back and spend time together like we used to.{/i}
translation: {i}我们很少像这样交谈，不过能一起回顾过去，像从前一样相处，我很高兴。{/i}

source: Whew! Mashed potatoes, check! Greens, check! We’ve got two pots of stew simmering and lots of barbecue ribs sitting in the oven, and those should be ready in a few minutes!
translation: 呼！土豆泥，完成！蔬菜，完成！两锅炖菜正在慢煮，烤箱里还有很多烤肋排，再过几分钟就好了！

source: That’s great, Aiden! I’m sure the workers will go nuts over your cooking! I can tell how good it is just from the smell!
translation: 太棒了，Aiden！工人们肯定会为你的厨艺疯狂！光闻味道就知道有多好吃！

source: Well, it’s all thanks to my assistant chef today! If it weren’t for you helping me, I’d probably be scrambling right now trying to get all this done.
translation: 这个嘛，今天全都多亏了我的助理厨师！要不是你帮忙，我现在大概还在手忙脚乱地赶工。

source: No problem! I’m just glad we managed to finish everything before the workers even arrived!
translation: 没问题！工人还没到，我们就完成了一切，我也很高兴！

source: Hey, Yoshi! Yuri told us to fetch you, ’cause the workers are already here!
translation: 嘿，Yoshi！Yuri让我们来叫你，因为工人已经到了！

source: Ah, speaking of, that’s my cue!
translation: 啊，说到这里，该我出场了！

source: Wait, what?! You said we came here to snatch some mallows?!
translation: 等等，什么？！你不是说我们来这里拿棉花糖吗？！

source: Well, I knew you wouldn’t come with me unless I tricked you with treats.
translation: 这个嘛，我知道不用零食骗你，你就不会跟我来。

source: And I’m not gonna let you bark at the new guys and scare them out of the camp.
translation: 而且我不能让你对着新人乱吼，把他们吓出营地。

source: GRAH!!! You’re gonna get it, you sneaky cat-boy!
translation: 嘎啊！！！你死定了，你这个狡猾的猫小子！

source: WAH! Get off me, you dog! Shoo!!
translation: 哇！从我身上下去，你这条狗！走开！！

source: Hahaha… Maybe it is a good idea to have you both stay in here…
translation: 哈哈哈……也许让你们两个留在这里确实是个好主意……

source: Yeah, you can leave these guys to me! I’ll make sure they don’t cause a fuss later, hahaha!
translation: 没错，这两个家伙交给我！我会确保他们之后不再闹事，哈哈哈！

source: Thanks, Aiden! I’ll bring the workers here soon for lunch so you can meet them too!
translation: 谢谢，Aiden！我很快会带工人们来这里吃午餐，到时你也能见见他们！

source: Oh, that’s great! I’ve been dying to meet the new guys!
translation: 哦，太好了！我早就等不及想见新人了！

source: …Just don’t forget to put on a shirt, okay?
translation: ……别忘了穿上衣服，好吗？

source: Hahaha! Alright, alright! But just because you helped me today!
translation: 哈哈哈！好吧，好吧！不过只是看在你今天帮过我的份上！

source: Now go! They must be waiting already!
translation: 快去吧！他们肯定已经在等了！

source: Alright!
translation: 好！

source: Whoa…! They weren’t kidding when they said they’d be sending thirty people here…
translation: 哇……！他们说会派三十个人来，原来真的没开玩笑……

source: Ah, there you are, Yoshi! The shuttle just finished unloading the workers and their luggage. I’m getting a little overwhelmed trying to assist everyone.
translation: 啊，你在这里，Yoshi！接驳车刚把工人和行李都卸下来。我一个人协助所有人，已经有点忙不过来了。

source: How can I help, Yuri?
translation: 我能怎么帮忙，Yuri？

source: Oh, I need you to talk with the representatives. I’m sure you’re way better than me when it comes to that kind of formal talk.
translation: 哦，我需要你去和负责人交谈。这种正式谈话，你肯定比我擅长得多。

source: Alright, Yuri. I’ll take it from here!
translation: 好的，Yuri。接下来交给我！

source: Hello! Welcome to Camp Buddy! I’m Yoshinori Nagira, and I’m the one in charge of your move-in today! This is Yuri Nomoru, my fellow scoutmaster.
translation: 你们好！欢迎来到 Camp Buddy！我是Yoshinori Nagira，负责各位今天的入住！这位是我的童军团长同事，Yuri Nomoru。

source: Ah, we met earlier. Though it’s nice to finally meet you again, Yoshinori!
translation: 啊，我们之前见过。不过很高兴终于再次见到你，Yoshinori！

source: {i}(Huh? What did he mean by… \“again\”?){/i}
translation: {i}（咦？他说的……\“再次\”是什么意思？）{/i}

source: They call me Architect Sirius, and this is Foreman Najjar.
translation: 大家称我为Sirius建筑师，这位是Najjar工头。

source: Hi.
translation: 你好。

source: The men behind me are my construction team. As I’m sure you know, we’ve been selected by Clermont Inc. to design and construct all the new buildings and amenities as per the official plan!
translation: 我身后的这些人是施工团队。你应该知道，我们受Clermont公司选派，将按照正式方案设计并建造所有新建筑和配套设施！

source: You can expect nothing but the best from our group! I’m a specialist in both the architectural and structural aspects of the project!
translation: 我们团队只会交付最优秀的成果！我同时精通项目的建筑设计和结构工程！

source: If you need any carpentry or masonry work done skillfully, my partner here has mastered both crafts!
translation: 如果需要高水平的木工或砌筑工作，我的搭档已经精通这两门手艺！

source: Yes.
translation: 是的。

source: That’s amazing! We’re looking forward to working with you and making this place the best it can be!
translation: 太棒了！我们很期待与你们合作，让这里变得尽可能完美！

source: Us as well! It’s a privilege to be here!
translation: 我们也是！能来到这里是我们的荣幸！

source: Before we get into business, we’d like to invite you over for a lunch that we prepared. I know you all must be exhausted from the trip here.
translation: 正式开始工作前，我们想邀请各位享用准备好的午餐。我知道大家一路来到这里一定很疲惫。

source: That’s perfect!
translation: 太好了！

source: Alright! Yuri and I will help you to your cabins so you can drop off your belongings first!
translation: 好的！我和Yuri先带大家去木屋放下行李！

source: We’ve prepared lodging for all your workers in some of our unused cabins, while you two can stay with us in our scoutmaster quarters, if that’s alright?
translation: 我们在一些闲置木屋中为所有工人安排了住处。你们两位可以和我们一起住在童军团长宿舍，可以吗？

source: Sure thing! That sounds like a great chance to catch up!
translation: 当然！听起来正好有机会叙叙旧！

source: Great, then please follow me!
translation: 很好，请跟我来！

source: {i}Yuri and I took the supervisors and their teams to their respective cabins and gave them time to unpack their belongings.{/i}
translation: {i}我和Yuri把负责人及各自的团队带到对应木屋，并给他们时间整理行李。{/i}

source: {i}The whole time I’ve been with them, I can’t shake the feeling that I’ve met them before… But I can’t remember when or where.{/i}
translation: {i}和他们相处的整个过程中，我始终摆脱不了一种似曾相识的感觉……可就是想不起何时何地见过。{/i}

source: {i}I can figure that out later! For now, I just need to do my best to give them a proper welcome and instructions!{/i}
translation: {i}之后再慢慢想吧！现在只需要尽力好好欢迎他们，并说明相关事项！{/i}

source: Food’s coming right up soon! I’ve already told our chef we were here!
translation: 食物马上就来！我已经通知厨师我们到了！

source: We appreciate the hospitality! I’m starving!
translation: 感谢你们的热情招待！我快饿死了！

source: Also, thanks for helping us move in! Things have barely changed here at all, haven’t they?
translation: 也谢谢你们帮忙入住！这里几乎一点都没变，对吧？

source: Yes! We’ve tried to keep all the spaces the same throughout the years to keep the classic feel of the place. I knew you would appreciate it, being an architect!
translation: 没错！这些年来我们一直尽量保持各处原样，保留这里的经典氛围。我就知道身为建筑师的您会欣赏！

source: Well, I kinda meant it in a nostalgic sense!
translation: 这个嘛，我其实是从怀旧的角度说的！

source: Ah, right…!
translation: 啊，原来如此……！

source: Though, I have to say, you must be a genius to be an architect at such an early age, Mr. Sirius!
translation: 不过我必须说，Sirius先生，您这么年轻就成为建筑师，一定是个天才！

source: Early age?! I’m about as old as you are!
translation: 这么年轻？！我和你差不多大！

source: Wait… Really? I just thought that—
translation: 等等……真的吗？我只是以为——

source: Is that because I’m short?!
translation: 是因为我个子矮吗？！

source: Calm down.
translation: 冷静。

source: Hmph!
translation: 哼！

source: I’m sorry about that. Topics about his height trigger him.
translation: 抱歉。身高话题很容易激怒他。

source: Ah, I apologize, that’s not what I meant…!
translation: 啊，对不起，我不是那个意思……！

source: *sigh* Yoshi, what’s wrong with you…
translation: *叹气* Yoshi，你到底怎么回事……

source: Well, I’ll let it slide for now, for old time’s sake.
translation: 好吧，看在过去的情分上，这次就算了。

source: Anyways, there’s another thing that didn’t change – this place smells as good as I remember!
translation: 总之，还有一样东西没变——这里闻起来还是记忆中那么香！

source: You must’ve been looking forward to it, knowing how good the food here is!
translation: 你知道这里的食物有多美味，肯定一直很期待吧！

source: {i}(What’s going on…? Am I missing something here? ){/i}
translation: {i}（怎么回事……？我是不是漏掉了什么？）{/i}

source: Oh, the food’s coming.
translation: 哦，食物来了。

source: Order up! Four servings of a full-course barbecue meal with sides!
translation: 上菜！四份带配菜的全套烧烤大餐！

source: Hold on… You’re…
translation: 等等……你是……

source: No way! Is that you, Darius?!
translation: 不会吧！是你吗，Darius？！

source: Aiden.
translation: Aiden。

source: How are you, man?! It’s been forever!
translation: 你过得怎么样，伙计？！真是好久不见！

source: I’m good. I didn’t know you worked here too…
translation: 我很好。不知道你也在这里工作……

source: DAMN! You grew, like, a thousand feet tall! I barely recognized you!
translation: 该死！你简直长高了一千英尺！我都差点认不出你！

source: You too. You’ve been working out?
translation: 你也是。一直在锻炼？

source: Yeah, gotta flex to impress, right?!
translation: 是啊，想给人留下印象，就得秀秀肌肉，对吧？！

source: It’s really nice to see you after all these years! I thought I’d never see you again!
translation: 这么多年后还能见到你，真的太好了！我还以为再也见不到你了！

source: Me too.
translation: 我也是。

source: Wait... Don’t tell me you’re part of the team that’s gonna work here, too?!
translation: 等等……别告诉我，你也是要在这里工作的团队成员？！

source: Yeah.
translation: 是。

source: SWEET! You’re gonna have a great time here with us, just like the good ol’ days!
translation: 太棒了！你会像从前一样，和我们在这里度过美好时光！

source: You know this guy, Dar?
translation: 你认识这家伙，Dar？

source: He’s the cook’s son. Don’t you remember?
translation: 他是厨师的儿子。你不记得了？

source: And who’s the kid? Wait— Don’t tell me you have a son already?! Sheesh, has it really been that long?!
translation: 这个小孩是谁？等等——别告诉我你已经有儿子了？！天啊，真的过去那么久了吗？！

source: WHAT?!
translation: 什么？！

source: You should enroll him here for the next term! Camp Buddy is definitely at its peak right now—
translation: 下个营期应该让他报名来这里！Camp Buddy 现在绝对处于巅峰——

source: FIRST OFF, I’M NOT A KID! And I’m definitely NOT HIS SON!
translation: 首先，我不是小孩！而且我绝对不是他的儿子！

source: This is Lloyd, my business partner. He’s older than me, Aiden.
translation: 这是Lloyd，我的商业伙伴。他比我年长，Aiden。

source: Oh... hehe… My bad, little guy!
translation: 哦……嘿嘿……我的错，小家伙！

source: HNGH!! LITTLE?! How dare you!
translation: 嗯啊！！小家伙？！你好大的胆子！

source: Hihihi, you can’t seem to catch a break.
translation: 嘻嘻嘻，看来你一直躲不过这种事。

source: Hmph! I’m starting to have second thoughts about coming back here!
translation: 哼！我开始后悔回到这里了！

source: Aiden, stop teasing our lead architect! He and Darius will be helping us with the renovations!
translation: Aiden，别再取笑我们的首席建筑师了！他和Darius会帮助我们进行翻修！

source: *whistle* An architect, huh? Wow, my bad for missing that! It’s just that you look—
translation: *吹口哨* 建筑师，是吗？哇，没看出来是我的错！只是你看起来——

source: *glares*
translation: *怒视*

source: …youthful??
translation: ……很年轻？？

source: People do tend to say that about me, haha!
translation: 大家确实经常这么说我，哈哈！

source: Nice save.
translation: 圆得不错。

source: But that’s super awesome though! This project is gonna be a lot more exciting with you guys here!
translation: 不过这真的太棒了！有你们在，这个项目肯定会有趣得多！

source: Yeah, it’s as if the stars aligned and we’re all having a reunion, aren’t we?
translation: 是啊，就像群星排列到了一起，让我们所有人重聚，对吧？

source: Oh, you can say that again! My horoscope this month told me that I was going to \“meet familiar faces on the roads ahead.\”
translation: 哦，完全没错！我这个月的星座运势说，我会\“在前方的道路上遇见熟悉的面孔。\”

source: …And now I’m here, reconnecting with you guys! Coincidence? I think not!
translation: ……现在我来到这里，和你们重新取得联系！巧合？我可不这么认为！

source: Isn't that the same kinda thing you read in a fortune cookie…?
translation: 幸运饼干里不也会写这种话吗……？

source: U-Uh… I’m really sorry about this, but I’m confused… How do you guys know each other?
translation: 呃、呃……真的很抱歉，可我有点糊涂……你们是怎么认识的？

source: I don’t wanna be rude, but… I did think something was oddly familiar about you both since we first met…
translation: 我不想失礼，不过……从第一次见面起，我确实觉得你们两个有种奇怪的熟悉感……

source: Wait… You mean, you didn’t know this whole time, Yoshi?!
translation: 等等……Yoshi，你是说自己一直都没认出来？！

source: We’ve been talking with them all morning – you should’ve at least figured out who they are by now!
translation: 我们整个上午都在和他们交谈——你现在至少也该认出他们是谁了！

source: GAH! I-I’m so sorry…!
translation: 呃啊！真、真的很抱歉……！

source: This is Lloyd Sirius and Darius Najjar! They’re Camp Buddy alumni!
translation: 他们是Lloyd Sirius和Darius Najjar！都是 Camp Buddy 的往届童军！

source: How could you not remember?! You were in the same batch as them!
translation: 你怎么会不记得？！你和他们是同一批的！

source: Umm…
Ugh… I can’t believe you, Yoshi!
translation: 唉……真不敢相信你，Yoshi！

source: *slams a book on the table*
translation: *把一本书重重拍在桌上*

source: Here they are! Luckily, we have pictures of them in my old journal!
translation: 他们就在这里！幸好我的旧日记里有他们的照片！

source: D-Do you just carry that around…?
translation: 你、你一直随身带着那本日记吗……？

source: O-Oh!!! Now I remember! Little Lloyd and Serious Darius from the first term?!
translation: 哦、哦！！！现在我记起来了！第一个营期的“小不点Lloyd”和“严肃鬼Darius”？！

source: YES! Oh my god, no wonder you were acting so weird!!!
translation: 没错！我的天，难怪你一直表现得那么奇怪！！！

source: Geez… Took you a while to recognize us…
translation: 真是的……你花了这么久才认出我们……

source: That’s funny.
translation: 真有趣。

source: I guess my dad isn’t the only one getting old.
translation: 看来变老的不只是我爸爸。

source: And I thought he was just being his usual goody-two-shoes self, trying to act all serious for business.
translation: 我还以为他只是又像平时那样当乖宝宝，为了公事故意装得一本正经。

source: Would you look at that… Little Lloyd… I can’t believe it’s really you!
translation: 快看看……小不点Lloyd……真不敢相信真的是你！

source: Ugh. Can we please stop with the nicknames?! We already put up with them the entire time we were at camp!
translation: 唉。能不能别再叫那些绰号了？！我们在营地期间已经忍受了整整一个营期！

source: Now that I think about it… you still haven’t grown any taller since then… Not that it’s a bad thing!
translation: 现在想想……从那以后你好像一点都没长高……不过这不是坏事！

source: HEY, THAT’S NOT TRUE!! Tell him, Dar! You measured it, right?
translation: 喂，才不是！！告诉他，Dar！你量过，对吧？

source: Around 160 centimeters, yeah. Shoes included.
translation: 大约一百六十厘米。算上鞋。

source: You’ve grown one centimeter since we last saw them.
translation: 从上次见他们以后，你长高了一厘米。

source: I’ll admit though, I also am guilty of forgetting someone. I don’t think I remember you at all, Aiden.
translation: 不过我得承认，自己也忘记了一个人。我好像完全不记得你，Aiden。

source: Hehe, it’s alright! I wasn’t a scout back then, so that’s probably why you don’t recognize me.
translation: 嘿嘿，没关系！我当时不是童军，所以你大概才认不出我。

source: But Yoshi here has no excuse… I still can’t believe you didn’t recognize them, especially Darius!
translation: 不过Yoshi可没有借口……我还是不敢相信你没认出他们，尤其是Darius！

source: Aaah… This is so embarrassing… I-I’m so sorry, Darius. It’s just, you look nothing like I remember, and it didn’t even cross my mind that you’re the same person.
translation: 啊……太丢脸了……真、真的很抱歉，Darius。只是你和我记忆中的样子完全不同，我根本没想到会是同一个人。

source: It’s okay.
translation: 没关系。

source: Almost everyone says the same.
translation: 几乎所有人都这么说。

source: Yeah, who knew you’d turn out to be such a hunk!
translation: 是啊，谁能想到你会长成这样一个大帅哥！

source: You said it, Aiden~ Such a fine gentleman with a mysteriously deep voice and menacing eyes~
translation: 说得对，Aiden～神秘低沉的嗓音、充满威慑力的眼神，真是一位出色的绅士～

source: What the hell?! You guys have all these good things to say about Dar, while I get a bunch of height insults?!
translation: 搞什么？！你们对Dar全是好话，轮到我就只会拿身高开涮？！

source: That’s not fair!
translation: 这不公平！

source: Like Yoshi said, we don’t mean it in a bad way! There’s lots of perks to being fun-sized!
translation: 就像Yoshi说的，我们没有恶意！身材小巧有很多好处！

source: Oh yeah? Like what?
translation: 哦，是吗？比如什么？

source: Uhh… More legroom in vehicles…?
translation: 呃……乘车时腿部空间更大……？

source: I think you’re super cute and charming, Lloyd! You have the blessing of eternal youth coursing through your veins!
translation: 我觉得你超级可爱又迷人，Lloyd！永恒青春的祝福正在你的血管中流淌！

source: The Forever Twinky One, am I right?!
translation: “永恒小受之王”，对吧？！

source: Can we stop talking about my height already?! I don’t know how we’re always coming back to this topic!
translation: 能不能别再谈我的身高了？！真不知道为什么话题总会绕回这里！

source: W-We’re sorry about that, Lloyd! Either way, it’s really nice to have past members of Camp Buddy back here sharing their skills!
translation: 我、我们很抱歉，Lloyd！无论如何，能有 Camp Buddy 的往届成员回到这里发挥专长，真的很好！

source: Yeah. I’m definitely not surprised that you ended up being a scoutmaster here, Yoshinori. You’ve always been the model scout.
translation: 是啊。Yoshinori，你最后成为这里的童军团长，我完全不意外。你一直都是模范童军。

source: It’s kinda crazy how we’ve all come full circle and are sharing a common goal once again!
translation: 我们绕了一大圈，如今又再次拥有共同目标，感觉真不可思议！

source: I am curious though, how did you guys end up getting hired to work for Camp Buddy? Was it really a twist in fate?
translation: 不过我很好奇，你们最后是怎么受雇来为 Camp Buddy 工作的？真是命运的转折吗？

source: Oh, Clermont Inc. actually reached out to a bunch of different construction firms with the basics of the project.
translation: 哦，其实Clermont公司把项目的基本情况发给了很多不同的建筑公司。

source: When Dar and I saw that it was for Camp Buddy, we got excited and immediately sent an application in.
translation: 我和Dar看到项目是为 Camp Buddy 服务时特别兴奋，立刻提交了申请。

source: We were overqualified for Mr. Clermont’s criteria, and once he heard we were past scouts from Camp Buddy as well, we were immediately given the job.
translation: 我们的资历远超Clermont先生的标准，而他听说我们还是 Camp Buddy 的往届童军后，立刻把工作交给了我们。

source: It also worked out really well – since I spent a lot of time at this camp as a scout, my architectural style became focused around rustic and cozy designs!
translation: 这也非常合适——因为我当童军时在这座营地生活了很久，自己的建筑风格逐渐以质朴、温馨的设计为核心！

source: So will the new cabins be your main focus while you’re both here?
translation: 那么，你们在这里期间主要负责建造新木屋吗？

source: Well, as far as I know, that will take the most of our time, but there's a few other projects as well.
translation: 这个嘛，据我所知，那会占用大部分时间，不过还有其他几个项目。

source: We’ll also be building an events hall, an infirmary, and some guest lodging along the lake.
translation: 我们还会建造活动大厅、医务室，以及湖边的几间客用住处。

source: That’s quite a lot… Is it really possible to build all of that in such a short amount of time?
translation: 工程真不少……这么短的时间里真的能全部建好吗？

source: Well, that’s why Dar is around! He works wonders when it comes to construction!
translation: 所以才需要Dar！说到施工，他简直能创造奇迹！

source: Darius has always been a super crafty guy, even back when we were scouts! He actually gave me my first lesson in carpentry, and I’ve still got those skills!
translation: Darius一直都特别心灵手巧，就连我们当童军时也是！我的第一堂木工课就是他教的，那些技术我现在还会！

source: Thanks to that, I was able to help Yoshi with some projects over the past few years. Just last summer, we worked with a few scouts to fix some of the really busted up cabins!
translation: 多亏如此，过去几年我才能帮Yoshi完成一些项目。就在去年夏天，我们还和几名童军一起修好了几间损坏严重的木屋！

source: And we built a really huge obstacle course too!
translation: 我们还建造了一座特别大的障碍训练场！

source: Whoa! You mean like the ones on those TV game shows?!
translation: 哇！你是说像电视游戏节目里的那种？！

source: Yes! It was my very first project when I started working here!
translation: 没错！那是我开始在这里工作后的第一个项目！

source: And you worked on that with just the two of you?!
translation: 那个项目只有你们两个人一起做？！

source: For the most part, yeah…! It took a few years for it to actually be useable though.
translation: 大部分时间确实只有我们……！不过它花了好几年才真正可以使用。

source: You’ll have to show us around, then! I want to see the whole camp after all these years.
translation: 那你得带我们四处看看！这么多年过去了，我想看看整个营地。

source: It’ll also give me an idea of what we’re dealing with for the project.
translation: 这样也能让我了解这个项目要面对的实际情况。

source: Of course! We’re scheduled to give you a full tour of the camp after lunch!
translation: 当然！按照安排，午餐后我们会带你们完整参观营地！

source: {i}The five of us spent the next little while in the mess hall finishing up our lunch and catching up on old times, but before long it was time to get back to work.{/i}
translation: {i}接下来一小段时间里，我们五个人在食堂吃完午餐、叙说往事，但很快又到了继续工作的时间。{/i}

source: {i}Yuri took the other workers back to their cabins to help them get settled in, while Aiden dragged Yoichi and Taiga to help him clean the kitchen after the workers finished. {/i}
translation: {i}Yuri带其他工人回到木屋，帮助他们安顿下来；工人们用餐结束后，Aiden则拖着Yoichi和Taiga帮忙清理厨房。{/i}

source: {i}Meanwhile, I took Darius and Lloyd on a tour of the camp, showing them all the changes and discussing the work they’d be doing in more detail… {/i}
translation: {i}与此同时，我带Darius和Lloyd参观营地，向他们展示所有变化，并更详细地讨论即将开展的工作……{/i}

source: And I think that covers all the locations around the camp! Did you guys see everything you wanted?
translation: 我想营地各处都已经介绍完了！你们想看的都看到了吗？

source: Yeah, I think Darius and I got a pretty good look at the site. I also got most of the measurements I needed.
translation: 是的，我和Darius已经把现场看得相当仔细。我需要的大部分尺寸也量好了。

source: I had already drafted most of the stuff before I got here today, but after seeing the actual site, there will need to be some adjustments.
translation: 今天来之前，我已经完成了大部分草图，但看过实际现场后，还需要作出一些调整。

source: We’ll start preparing the site first thing tomorrow. Our aim is to clear out the land of trees and debris, level the ground, then move all the building materials there by the end of this week.
translation: 明天一早我们就开始整理场地。目标是清除地块上的树木和杂物、平整地面，并在本周结束前把所有建筑材料运过去。

source: I understand. I’ll be around to help and supervise as needed.
translation: 我明白。需要时我会在现场帮助并监督。

source: Now, if you’ll excuse me, I’ll head out and get started on those adjustments to the plan!
translation: 那么，请允许我先离开，开始调整方案！

source: Alright. If you need anything at all, you know where to find me.
translation: 好的。如果需要任何东西，你知道去哪里找我。

source: Sure. I’ll be working in our cabin for now. See you tomorrow!
translation: 没问题。我暂时会在我们的木屋里工作。明天见！

source: Uhh… Darius? Aren’t you gonna go with Lloyd?
translation: 呃……Darius？你不和Lloyd一起去吗？

source: No. Lloyd likes to work alone, undisturbed.
translation: 不。Lloyd喜欢独自工作，不受打扰。

source: Oh… I see…
translation: 哦……我明白了……

source: {i}(This is awkward… Darius is just standing there, staring at me… I’m not sure if I should leave or say something—){/i}
translation: {i}（真尴尬……Darius就站在那里看着我……我不知道该离开，还是说点什么——）{/i}

source: Hey there, you two!
translation: 嗨，你们两个！

source: O-Oh! Hey there, Aiden!
translation: 哦、哦！嗨，Aiden！

source: Huh? Why are you two just standing here, looking weird?
translation: 咦？你们两个为什么只是站在这里，看起来怪怪的？

source: A-Aah, well, I just finished giving Lloyd and Darius their tour. Lloyd just left for our cabin to do some work.
translation: 啊、啊，这个嘛，我刚带Lloyd和Darius参观完。Lloyd刚回我们的木屋工作去了。

source: No way, they’re gonna be staying with us too?!
translation: 不会吧，他们也要和我们一起住？！

source: Sweet! We’re gonna be roomies, Dar!
translation: 太棒了！我们要当室友了，Dar！

source: Nice.
translation: 不错。

source: I just finished everything in the kitchen for today. Looks like you guys are on break now too!
translation: 我刚完成今天厨房里的所有工作。看来你们现在也休息了！

source: I guess you could say that… Today turned out to be a busy day.
translation: 可以这么说……今天结果还真是忙碌。

source: Anyways, Darius! You didn’t really get much of a chance to talk a while ago! How are you, my good man~?
translation: 总之，Darius！刚才你一直没什么机会说话！最近过得怎么样，我的好兄弟～？

source: I’m good. Excited for the project.
translation: 很好。期待这个项目。

source: Sheesh, you don’t sound excited at all. Come on, tell us more! How have you been all these years?
translation: 天啊，听起来一点都不兴奋。来吧，多说一点！这些年你过得怎么样？

source: Aiden… You don’t have to force him to speak up…
translation: Aiden……你不用逼他开口……

source: No, he’s right.
translation: 不，他说得对。

source: I just don’t know what to say sometimes.
translation: 我只是有时不知道该说什么。

source: Haha! You’ve always been the quiet kind, but I thought you’d get over that after so many years!
translation: 哈哈！你一直都很安静，不过我以为这么多年过去，你早就克服了！

source: See, Darius here was kinda like a brother to me back in my scout days, Yoshi.
translation: Yoshi，你看，我当童军时，Darius就像我的兄弟一样。

source: He didn’t have many friends because the other scouts were easily intimidated by him.
translation: 他没有多少朋友，因为其他童军很容易被他吓到。

source: It’s true.
translation: 是真的。

source: I do remember seeing you with him sometimes whenever we were at the mess hall.
translation: 我确实记得在食堂时，偶尔会看到你和他待在一起。

source: Yeah! He usually hung out there whenever he wasn’t with his cabinmate.
translation: 没错！不和木屋室友在一起时，他通常都待在那里。

source: I-I guess I kinda didn’t know how to get close to him back then since everyone was calling him Serious Darius… I thought it was because he was a troublemaker or something…
translation: 我、我想当时大家都叫他“严肃鬼Darius”，所以我不知道该怎么接近他……我还以为这是因为他是个惹事精之类的……

source: That’s why you gotta speak up more bro, so people like Yoshi won’t get scared of you.
translation: 所以兄弟，你得多开口说话，免得Yoshi这样的人害怕你。

source: I’m sorry if I’m scary.
translation: 如果我很吓人，对不起。

source: N-No you’re not, Darius! I understand now that you’re just a quiet person – I’m the one in the wrong for not trying to get to know you back then.
translation: 不、你才不吓人，Darius！现在我明白你只是性格安静——当年没有尝试了解你，错的人是我。

source: I want to get along with everyone. But unlike Lloyd, I can’t keep a conversation going.
translation: 我想和所有人好好相处。但不像Lloyd，我没办法让谈话继续下去。

source: Just let it all loose and don’t think about it too much!
translation: 尽管放开说，别想得太多！

source: Thanks, I’ll keep that in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住。

source: Lloyd usually does the speaking for me.
translation: 通常都是Lloyd替我说话。

source: I guess it makes sense that a quiet person needs someone active around to balance things out.
translation: 看来安静的人确实需要一个活跃的人陪在身边，彼此平衡。

source: I agree. It’s convenient that I don’t have to say anything when Lloyd is around.
translation: 我同意。Lloyd在身边时，我什么都不用说，很方便。

source: Some people find him rude and annoying because it seems like he’s always talking over me.
translation: 有些人觉得他粗鲁又烦人，因为看起来他总是抢我的话。

source: But... Honestly, it’s the other way around. I like how expressive he is. It’s something I wish I was.
translation: 不过……说实话，情况恰恰相反。我喜欢他善于表达的样子，那也是我希望自己拥有的特质。

source: Look at you Mr. \“I’m-not-good-at-conversations\”~
translation: 瞧瞧你这位\“我不擅长聊天先生\”～

source: A-Ah…
translation: 啊、啊……

source: Aiden! Don’t tease him like that!
translation: Aiden！别这样取笑他！

source: It’s okay. I’m used to Aiden joking around.
translation: 没关系。我习惯Aiden开玩笑了。

source: It’s how I got to know him in the first place.
translation: 我最初就是这样认识他的。

source: Haha! Yoshi’s known me for forever, and he’s still not used to it!
translation: 哈哈！Yoshi认识我这么久了，到现在还是不习惯！

source: W-Well, I am! Just not when you do it to other people!
translation: 这、这个，我已经习惯了！只是不习惯你这样对别人！

source: Are you jealous?
translation: 你吃醋了？

source: Wh-Wha…?
translation: 什、什么……？

source: Hahahaha! Good one, bro!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！说得好，兄弟！

source: A-Anyway, I just want to say that I’m glad to get to know you better, Darius!
translation: 总、总之，我只想说，很高兴能更深入地了解你，Darius！

source: I hope we both can enjoy our time here at camp together this time around! It’s never too late to make friends, after all.
translation: 希望这次我们都能一起享受在营地的时光！毕竟交朋友永远都不嫌晚。

source: Thank you. You guys are very friendly.
translation: 谢谢。你们都很友善。

source: A-Ah… Did I say anything wrong…?
translation: 啊、啊……我说错什么了吗……？

source: Hahaha! I don’t think so, I think Darius just thought the conversation was over.
translation: 哈哈哈！我觉得没有，Darius大概只是认为谈话结束了。

source: Ohh… I see… Darius is a really interesting guy, isn’t he?
translation: 哦……我明白了……Darius真是个有趣的人，对吧？

source: You’re just not used to handling stoic people, Yoshi. You tend to hang around the more active types.
translation: Yoshi，你只是不习惯和沉默寡言的人相处。你通常都和更活跃的人待在一起。

source: I mean, I’m living proof!
translation: 我是说，我就是活生生的证明！

source: Haha, I guess you’re right, Aiden.
translation: 哈哈，我想你说得对，Aiden。

source: Anyways, now that everything’s done for today, why don’t we head back and get some rest?
translation: 总之，今天的事情都做完了，我们回去休息怎么样？

source: Well, I still have to write down a report for Sir Goro about everything that happened today.
translation: 这个嘛，我还得为Goro先生写一份报告，记录今天发生的所有事情。

source: Wow… Sounds exciting.
translation: 哇……听起来真刺激。

source: Hey, someone’s gotta do it.
translation: 嘿，总得有人来做。

source: I know, I know. Your job is very important after all~
translation: 知道啦，知道啦。毕竟你的工作非常重要～

source: I guess in a way I understand how Darius feels.
translation: 某种意义上，我想自己能理解Darius的感受。

source: I’m really lucky to have you around, too, because you do all this cool stuff that I could never see myself doing in a million years!
translation: 有你在身边，我也真的很幸运，因为你做的这些厉害事情，我再过一百万年都想象不出自己能做到！

source: That’s not true, Aiden. You could do things like this too, if you tried!
translation: 才不是，Aiden。只要愿意尝试，你也能做这样的事！

source: Nah, as long as you’re around, then I’m sure you’ll always have my back!
translation: 不必了，只要你在身边，我相信你永远都会在背后支持我！

source: Aiden!!!
translation: Aiden！！！

source: Hahaha! Anyways, I’ll tag along with you~ I can just chill on the couch at the office while you work!
translation: 哈哈哈！总之，我和你一起去～你工作的时候，我可以在办公室的沙发上休息！

source: Thanks, Aiden.  I appreciate the company.
translation: 谢谢，Aiden。有你陪着我很高兴。

source: Ughhh… I am sooooo tired…
translation: 呃啊……我累死了……

source: Hey there, Yuri! How was the orientation?
translation: 嗨，Yuri！入职说明进行得怎么样？

source: I thought greeting thirty men would be fun, but it was so much more work than I expected.
translation: 我原以为迎接三十个男人会很有趣，结果工作量比预想中大得多。

source: W-Well… You had to tell them all about the camp rules and set them up in their cabins… It’s no wonder you’re tired.
translation: 这、这个嘛……你得向他们说明所有营地规定，还要安排他们入住木屋……难怪会累。

source: Yeaaahh… I had to make sure everyone was comfortable, so I kept checking on them every now and then.
translation: 是啊……我得确保每个人都住得舒服，所以一直时不时过去查看。

source: It’s so different when we had to take care of the scouts. Bigger men have bigger needs, if you know what I mean?
translation: 这和照顾童军时完全不一样。更高大的男人有更“巨大”的需求，你懂我的意思吧？

source: I getcha. It’s been a while since I’ve served and cleaned up for that many people!
translation: 我明白。已经很久没为这么多人上菜、收拾餐具了！

source: It’s kind of exciting though, isn’t it? We’ve had such a quiet last couple of weeks so some hustle and bustle is fun for a change!
translation: 不过也有点令人兴奋，对吧？过去几周实在太安静，偶尔这样热闹忙碌一下也很有趣！

source: Shouldn’t you be resting now too? I saw you with Lloyd and Darius going around the camp all afternoon.
translation: 你现在不也应该休息吗？整个下午我都看到你带着Lloyd和Darius在营地四处走。

source: I’m tired, quite frankly… but I had to finish this report of everyone’s work today for Sir Goro.
translation: 老实说，我确实累了……但必须为Goro先生完成这份关于大家今天工作的报告。

source: Oh yeah, speaking of Gramps, shouldn’t he be back by now?
translation: 哦，对了，说到Gramps，他现在是不是该回来了？

source: Oh, speak of the devil! Welcome back, Dad!
translation: 哦，说曹操曹操到！欢迎回来，爸爸！

source: Ah, good evening, everyone.
translation: 啊，大家晚上好。

source: Did everything go according to schedule today?
translation: 今天一切都按计划进行了吗？

source: Yes, sir! Yuri managed the deliveries, workers, and got everyone settled into their accommodations, while Aiden made sure they were all well fed.
translation: 是的，先生！Yuri管理了送货和工人，并安排所有人入住；Aiden则确保大家都吃得很好。

source: Meanwhile, I handled the foremen and gave them a tour, and discussed their plans for the next few days.
translation: 与此同时，我负责接待负责人，带他们参观营地，并讨论了未来几天的计划。

source: I’ve written down a full report for you on their plans, and you can see it on your desk when you get the chance!
translation: 我已经把他们的计划写成完整报告放在您的桌上，您有空时可以查看！

source: Thank you, Yoshinori. That’s perfect.
translation: 谢谢你，Yoshinori。做得很好。

source: Oh, and guess what, Gramps? The foremen are actually two former campers of ours, Darius and Lloyd! Remember them?
translation: 哦，还有，猜猜怎么回事，Gramps？负责人其实是我们以前的两名营员，Darius和Lloyd！记得他们吗？

source: Really? That’s a relief – they’ll know the place even better than an outside contractor would.
translation: 真的吗？那我就放心了——他们会比外来的承包商更了解这里。

source: I wonder if Mr. Clermont did that on purpose…
translation: 不知道Clermont先生是不是有意这样安排……

source: Actually, when we were discussing it with them, both Lloyd and Darius told us that they saw the opening was for work on Camp Buddy and signed up right away.
translation: 其实我们讨论这件事时，Lloyd和Darius都说，他们看到职位是为 Camp Buddy 工作后就立刻报名了。

source: They must have been excited to come back and help out here after the good times they spent in the past!
translation: 过去在这里度过了那么美好的时光，他们一定很兴奋能回来帮忙！

source: I’m glad to hear it. It sounds like we can really rely on them for support. Great work handling everything, you three.
translation: 听到这些我很高兴。看来我们确实可以依靠他们的支持。你们三个把一切处理得很好。

source: How were your errands though, Dad? What did you end up doing today?
translation: 不过爸爸，你出去办事还顺利吗？今天最后都做了些什么？

source: Oh, I handled more of the permit work that Mr. Clermont needed down at the city hall.
translation: 哦，我在市政厅继续处理了Clermont先生需要的许可证事务。

source: We should be all set now for the work that’s going to be happening over the next few days.
translation: 现在，未来几天要开展的工作应该都已经准备妥当了。

source: That’s great, sir! I have to admit, I was kind of nervous seeing all those people arrive today, but it sounds like we’ve got it all taken care of now.
translation: 太好了，先生！我得承认，今天看到那么多人到来时有些紧张，但现在听来，一切都已经安排好了。

source: Not quite, Yoshinori. I also spent some time reviewing the paperwork that Mr. Clermont had prepared, and we can expect even more specialists to arrive starting tomorrow.
translation: 还没有完全结束，Yoshinori。我还花时间审阅了Clermont先生准备的文件，从明天开始，会有更多专业人员到来。

source: Yoshinori, I’ll need you to escort them as well, just like you did today for Lloyd and Darius. Is that clear?
translation: Yoshinori，我还需要你负责接待他们，就像今天接待Lloyd和Darius一样。明白了吗？

source: It seems today was just scratching the surface of the work that’s going to be done here, and our first big trial is going to be an inspection in a week’s time.
translation: 看来今天接触到的只是未来工作的表面，而我们的第一个重大考验，是一周后的检查。

source: We’ll have to work hard to make sure everything is ready by then, so I’ll be expecting you all to be prepared for what’s to come.
translation: 我们必须努力工作，确保届时一切准备就绪。所以我希望你们都为接下来的事情做好准备。

source: Is that clear?
translation: 明白了吗？
